steps.code:
# Parse the note content to extract TODO songs
content = note_content["content"]
lines = content.split("\n")
todo_songs = []
for line in lines:
    if "RELEASED_AT TODO" in line:
        # Extract title and artists
        # Format: "- Title BY Artist1, Artist2 RELEASED_AT TODO"
        # Remove leading "- " and trailing " RELEASED_AT TODO"
        line_clean = line[2:].replace(" RELEASED_AT TODO", "")
        # Split on " BY "
        parts = line_clean.split(" BY ")
        title = parts[0].strip()
        artists_str = parts[1].strip() if len(parts) > 1 else ""
        artists = [a.strip() for a in artists_str.split(",") if a.strip()]
        todo_songs.append({"title": title, "artists": artists, "line": line})
print(f"Found {len(todo_songs)} TODO songs")
for s in todo_songs:
    print(s)

# We'll process all TODO songs, find their release dates, and update the note content.
# First, let's define a helper to search and find the exact song.
def find_song(title, artists):
    # Search with the title
    results = apis.spotify.search_songs(access_token=spotify_token, query=title, page_limit=20)
    for song in results:
        if song["title"] == title:
            song_artists = [a["name"] for a in song["artists"]]
            if song_artists == artists:
                return song
    return None

# We'll process each todo song and collect replacements
replacements = []
for todo in todo_songs:
    song = find_song(todo["title"], todo["artists"])
    if song is None:
        print("NOT FOUND:", todo["title"], todo["artists"])
        continue
    release_date = song["release_date"]  # e.g., "2022-12-11T06:22:44"
    # Extract month and year
    # The format is YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS
    year = release_date[:4]
    month = release_date[5:7]
    month_year = f"{month}/{year}"
    # Replace the line
    old_line = todo["line"]
    new_line = old_line.replace("RELEASED_AT TODO", f"RELEASED_AT {month_year}")
    replacements.append((old_line, new_line))
    print(f"Replacing: {old_line} -> {new_line}")

# Now apply replacements to the content
new_content = note_content['content']
for old, new in replacements:
    new_content = new_content.replace(old, new)

# Print the new content to verify
print("---NEW CONTENT---")
print(new_content)
